skill3.name: Twilight: Imposing Peak
skill3.description:
Ultimate DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{0}%</>.
After the wielder applies <#ba.airborne>Lift</>, during the next ultimate cast within 30s, the wielder gains Physical DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{1}%</>.
<@ba.info>Max stacks for effects of the same name: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.5s.</>

skill3.name: Flow: Reincarnation
skill3.description:
Physical DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{0}%</>.
After the wielder's skill recovers SP, the wielder gains Physical DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{1}%</> while other operators in the team gain Physical DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{2}%</> for 30s.
<@ba.info>Max stacks for effects of the same name: 5. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.1s.</>

skill3.name: Twilight: Lingering Glow
skill3.description:
ATK <@ba.vup>+{0}%</>.
When the wielder's skill applies <#ba.noguard>Vulnerability</>, during the next ultimate cast within 30s, the wielder gains DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{1}%</>.
<@ba.info>Max stacks for effects of the same name: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately. Effect only triggers once every 0.5s.</>

skill3.name: Infliction: Sincere Interrogation
skill3.description:
Secondary Attribute <@ba.vup>+{0}%</>.

skill3.name: Flow: Unbridled Edge
skill3.description:
Secondary Attribute <@ba.vup>+{0}%</>.
After the wielder's skill recovers SP, the entire team gains Heat DMG Dealt and Electric DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{1}%</> for 20s.
<@ba.info>Max stacks for effects of the same name: 3. Duration of each stack is counted separately.</>

skill3.name: Suppression: Fin Chaser's Intent
skill3.description:
ATK <@ba.vup>+{0}%</>.
When the wielder's battle skill applies <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>, target enemy suffers Cryo DMG Taken <@ba.vup>+{1}%</> for 15s.
<@ba.info>Effects of the same name cannot stack.</>

skill3.name: Infliction: Long Time Wish
skill3.description:
Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+{0}</>.
When the wielder applies <#ba.originium>Originium Crystals</> or <#ba.frozen>Solidification</>, during the next battle skill or ultimate cast within 20s, the wielder gains Physical DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{1}%</>.
<@ba.info>Effects of the same name cannot stack.</>

skill3.name: Fracture: Gnashing Wolves
skill3.description:
ATK <@ba.vup>+{0}%</>.
After the wielder's skill deals Critical DMG, the wielder gains 1 stack of <@ba.key>Wolven Blood</> that grants Physical and Heat DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{1}%</>. <@ba.key>Wolven Blood</> can reach 16 stacks. After reaching 16 stacks, the wielder gains another Physical and Heat DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{2}%</> for 20s. After the duration ends, all <@ba.key>Wolven Blood</> stacks are removed.

skill3.name: Assault: Vision for Tomorrow
skill3.description:
When entering battle, the entire team gains the <@ba.key>Dream Striving</> buff that grants DMG Dealt <@ba.vup>+{0}%</>, Arts Intensity <@ba.vup>+{1}</>, and DEF <@ba.vup>+{2}%</> for 20s. When <@ba.key>Dream Striving</> ends, the wielder restores the entire team for <@ba.heal>122</> HP.
<@ba.info>Effects of the same name cannot stack.</>
